answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity and commit to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations authenticate rate-limited messages. Zero-knowledge membership proofs conceal identity, while an epoch nullifier limits permitted messages. Sending distinct messages that reuse the nullifier exposes conflicting Shamir shares; interpolation recovers the private key, making duplicate messaging verifiable and triggering immediate collateral slashing. This cryptographic terrace guards the harbor of shared communication, with bonded stake as basalt beneath the rule.
